facts.fact: SASSA's acting Chief Information Officer told Parliament's social development committee that the Social Relief of Distress (SRD) system, established in 2020, processes about 17.8 million applications with an average of 8 million approvals a month, validated through real-time interfaces with Home Affairs, SARS, GEPF and DPSA.
SASSA told the committee it uses banking checks to prevent fraudulent grant payments and that only fully FICA-compliant bank accounts are now used for grant payments.
